findings.title: OS Command Injection
findings.assumptions: The function is expected to format numbers with commas, but the use of sprintf with an attacker-controlled integer could lead to unexpected behavior if num is very large or negative.

findings.title: Buffer Overflow
findings.assumptions: The calculation of finalLength may overflow if num is very large, leading to an underestimation of the required buffer size.

findings.title: Null Pointer Dereference
findings.assumptions: If num is negative, the length calculation may result in a zero or negative value, leading to an out-of-bounds write when setting the null terminator.

findings.title: Incorrect Calculation of Array Index
findings.assumptions: The calculation of commaPosition and the decrement of j may lead to an out-of-bounds write if num is very large.
